Deploy & Host ReelMorph AI Publicly

This application is 100% self-contained static HTML5/JS/Canvas

Because ReelMorph AI requires zero server infrastructure or database setup, you can publish it anywhere in under 60 seconds for free:

Option A: Vercel (Fastest)
1. Save this file as index.html
2. Run 'npx vercel' in the folder or push to GitHub and import repository.
3. Instantly hosted with global CDN.
Option B: GitHub Pages (100% Free)
1. Push index.html to a new repository
2. Go to Settings → Pages → Deploy from branch 'main'
3. Live at https://username.github.io/reelmorph/
Option C: Netlify / Cloudflare Pages

Simply drag-and-drop the folder containing index.html directly onto Netlify Drop or Cloudflare Pages Dashboard.

How ReelMorph AI Deconstruction Works

1
URL or Video Ingestion:

Paste any Instagram Reel, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts link (or upload an MP4). The engine analyzes the visual flow and acoustic frequencies.

2
Cut & Speed Ramp Recovery:

Using frame delta calculation, the analyzer identifies hard cuts, whip transitions, and non-linear speed ramps (e.g. 2.5x rush slowing down into a 0.5x slow-mo beat hit).

3
Template Slot Construction:

The finished reel is transformed into modular editable slots with exact timestamps, target energy ratings, and transition tags.

4
Media Replacement & Re-Rendering:

Assign your own photos/videos from gallery or device. Watch your own media immediately dance to the exact viral timing and export as a new video or CapCut/Premiere XML!
